# Overview

## Study background

::: {.report-card}
### Study description

**Scenario Group I** investigates an experimental **Bictegravir-like drug** in a **single-dose, four-arm, parallel-group, oral-administration Phase I study**.

According to the assignment, the compound is an HIV-1 integrase strand transfer inhibitor (INSTI), intended for once-daily oral dosing. It is highly bound to plasma proteins and primarily undergoes *in vitro* UGT1A1-mediated glucuronidation.

**Proposed compound name:** *To be determined by the group.*
:::

::: {.soft-card}
### Purpose of this report

This HTML report serves as the **reproducibility dashboard**. It records each input, R command, quality check, analysis decision, result, and output so that another team member can reproduce the work from the original data.

**Current status:** Template prepared; analyses and results will be added step by step.
:::

## Workflow map

```{=html}
<div class="workflow-strip" aria-label="Analysis workflow">
  <span>Raw data</span><b>→</b><span>Data QC</span><b>→</b><span>Cleaning</span><b>→</b><span>Descriptive analysis</span><b>→</b><span>NCA</span><b>→</b><span>Covariate analysis</span><b>→</b><span>Model proposal</span>
</div>
```

For every step, follow the same documentation pattern: **objective → code/method → checks and decisions → output and interpretation**.
